nodes.description: Public uint256 total token supply declared in LCCOINToken.
Mapping address => uint256 holding token balances in LCCOINStandardToken.
Nested mapping address => address => uint256 storing allowances.
Public string token name.
Public uint8 number of decimals.
Public string token symbol.
Public string token version, never written.
Caller-controlled address used to index balances and allowed.
transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) moves tokens from msg.sender to _to with overflow/underflow unchecked arithmetic (Solidity 0.4.x).
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) moves tokens using allowance of msg.sender.
balanceOf(address _owner) returns balances[_owner].
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
allowance(address _owner, address _spender) returns the remaining allowance.
Constructor assigning initial balances, totalSupply, name, decimals and symbol.
approveAndCall(address _spender, uint256 _value) sets allowance but performs no external call despite its name.
balances[_to] += _value; unchecked addition in transfer and transferFrom.
balances[msg.sender] -= _value; unchecked subtraction in transfer.
balances[_from] -= _value; unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value; unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
balances[msg.sender] = _initialAmount and totalSupply = _initialAmount state assignment in constructor (no upper-bound validation).
Destination address parameter of transfer, transferFrom, approve, approveAndCall.
Amount parameter of transfer, transferFrom, approve and approveAndCall.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Owner address parameter of balanceOf and allowance.
Spender address parameter of approve and allowance.
Initial supply parameter of the constructor.
Token name string parameter of the constructor.
Decimals parameter of the constructor.
Token symbol string parameter of the constructor.

edges.reason: transfer indexes balances with the caller-supplied msg.sender.
transferFrom checks allowed[_from][msg.sender] and spends from msg.sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with the initial amount.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
msg.sender value flows into the unchecked subtraction balances[msg.sender] -= _value.
msg.sender flows into the nested allowance subtraction allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
msg.sender receives the initial balance assignment in the constructor.
transfer executes balances[msg.sender] -= _value with unchecked underflow risk.
transfer executes balances[_to] += _value with unchecked overflow risk.
transferFrom executes balances[_from] -= _value with unchecked underflow risk.
transferFrom executes allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
transferFrom executes balances[_to] += _value with unchecked overflow risk.
constructor performs the initial balance and totalSupply assignment.
balances mapping is mutated by the unchecked addition.
balances mapping is mutated by the unchecked subtraction.
balances[_from] is mutated by the unchecked subtraction.
allowance update in transferFrom is coupled with balances mutation.
allowed mapping value is decremented without overflow protection.
constructor writes the initial entry of the balances mapping.
constructor sets totalSupply from _initialAmount.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
constructor writes the balances mapping.
constructor writes totalSupply.
constructor writes the name state variable.
constructor writes the decimals state variable.
constructor writes the symbol state variable.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping.
_to is the transfer destination and is checked against address(0).
_value drives the unchecked balance updates in transfer.
_value is added to balances[_to] without overflow check.
_value is subtracted from balances[msg.sender] without underflow check.
_from selects the source account in transferFrom.
_value drives the unchecked balance and allowance updates in transferFrom.
_owner indexes balances in balanceOf.
_spender is the key written in approve.
_owner indexes allowed in allowance.
_spender indexes allowed in allowance.
_initialAmount sets balances and totalSupply in the constructor.
_tokenName sets the name state variable.
_decimalUnits sets the decimals state variable.
_tokenSymbol sets the symbol state variable.
_spender parameter position is shared with the approve signature.

_value is written into allowed in approveAndCall.
_from keys the unchecked subtraction of the source balance.
_from keys the unchecked allowance subtraction.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only meaningful as the transfer/transferFrom destination argument, so it collapses into the transfer function node.
_value is the amount processed by transfer and its unchecked balance arithmetic.
_from only exists as the source account argument of transferFrom.
_owner is the account queried by balanceOf (and allowance).
_spender is the allowance key written by approve.
_initialAmount only feeds the constructor state initialization.
_tokenName is only assigned to name in the constructor.
_decimalUnits is only assigned to decimals in the constructor.
_tokenSymbol is only assigned to symbol in the constructor.
